# Seng Soon Air-Cond & Refrigerator Servicing

> Local air conditioner shop in Taman Sungai Kapar Indah, Klang, Selangor, Malaysia. Sells, installs, services, washes and repairs air conditioners for homes, offices and shops in Klang, Kapar, Bukit Raja and Setia Alam.

The business also sells aircond spare parts and buys or sells second-hand air conditioners in good condition, subject to stock availability. Brands handled include Daikin, Panasonic, Midea and Acson. Staff speak English, Malay and Chinese, and the site is published in all three languages. WhatsApp is the primary contact channel.

Address: 24, Jalan Sungai Kapar Indah 3, Taman Sungai Kapar Indah, 42200 Klang, Selangor, Malaysia
Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-283 5522
Hours: Monday to Friday 09:00-18:00, Saturday 09:00-17:00, Malaysia time (Sunday closed)

This is a single-page site. The whole page is short enough to read directly.
